sections.heading: Roof Cleaning and Soft Washing FAQs for Bloomfield, New Jersey

faqs.q: Does pressure washing damage shingles on a Bloomfield roof?

runs.v: Yes, so the answer to "Can I pressure wash moss off my roof?" is no: pressure-washing an asphalt shingle roof causes granule loss and premature failure of the roof system, per ARMA. Newark Quality Roofing uses the ARMA 50:50 chlorine-bleach-and-water solution and a low-pressure rinse, which kills moss, algae, and lichen by chemical action.

faqs.q: What causes the dark streaks on Bloomfield roofs?

runs.v: If you notice dark streaks, they are usually Gloeocapsa magma, the most prevalent roof-discoloration algae, which feeds on the limestone filler in asphalt shingles, per ARMA. Shaded north-facing slopes under Bloomfield's mature trees grow it fastest, so the wash targets those slopes first.

faqs.q: Does moss cause leaks on a Bloomfield roof?

runs.v: It can. Moss lifts and curls shingle edges, raises the risk of blow-off, and in severe build-up moves water laterally to the roof deck, which leads to moisture damage or leaks, per ARMA.

faqs.q: How often should a Bloomfield roof be cleaned?

runs.v: The NRCA recommends a roof inspection at least twice a year, spring and fall, plus one after any major storm, which sets the cadence for checking growth. Asphalt shingle roofs typically last about 20-30 years in New Jersey, and regular cleaning keeps moss from shortening that span.

faqs.q: Do zinc or copper strips prevent moss and algae on a Bloomfield roof?

runs.v: Zinc and copper inhibit algae growth, per ARMA, but ARMA does not recommend adding strips to an existing roof, because the exposed nails cause leaks or break the sealant bond. Newark Quality Roofing installs strips only with a roof replacement.

faqs.q: How much does roof cleaning moss removal cost in Bloomfield, NJ?

runs.v: Roof cleaning costs $300-$1,050 at $0.20-$0.70 per square foot, per This Old House, and a moss-prevention treatment adds $150-$250. North-facing slopes with heavy moss that needs hand removal sit at the higher end.
